title: Codex Scientiae registry header record
description: The container row opening a registry store. Extends the base JSONL header with what a registry additionally claims: which properties address its members, and how many it holds. Two things are deliberately absent, for one reason: this row describes the POPULATION, not the write that emitted it. created_at would make an unchanged population produce different bytes on every rebuild, destroying the reproducibility that ordering and wholesale rebuild exist to provide -- and the .sig already carries a created_at scoped to the write. The population's source is absent on the same principle, plus one of its own: a root path inside an artifact is a locality claim that stops being true when the tree moves.

kind.description: The KIND of the registry this header opens.

version.description: The declaring kind's VERSION, not the schema's.

identity.description: Properties addressing one member, copied from the record schema's x-identity. Restated here so a reader learns the key without resolving the record schema, and so a registry rebuilt under a changed identity is detectable.

count.description: Members in this registry, excluding the header row.
